findings.topic: original child result versus observer result
findings.conclusion: Original CLI child integer return is recorded immediately at165-167 before after-snapshot and hashes; later observer failures preserve child_exit_code and mark not_passed. Host separately records Docker attach/container/observer/original child outcomes. Passed requires all actual exits0,not timed_out,complete equal source and clean expected head.

Source and shared common Git are bound at identical absolute paths RO, observer RO and separate output RW; host inspects exact bind destinations/sources/RW and actual NetworkMode none before start. Container verifies ST_RDONLY for source/Git/observer and writable output. No interface-name heuristic.

findings.topic: no implicit fetch/pull or source modifications
findings.conclusion: Host/container GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1,terminal prompt disabled,optional locks disabled, Docker --pull=never; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Missing partial-clone object is allowed to fail proof, never silently fetch. No checkouts/config edits/guard imports in host preflight.

Original CLI argv is unchanged: /usr/local/bin/python3 scripts/verify_reviewed_source_v15.py --source-version p8-completion-source-20261009-v15. The observer binds actual G/tree,P,R,guard/registry/review hashes and four pins,requires G parent R and R parent P,complete product/validation mode/blob and clean head. No monkeypatch or replacement validator.

TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP point to writable /output/tmp. Original v15/v14 history helpers use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory without overriding dir,so their Python temporary roots use this output mount,not the unrelated64MiB /tmp tmpfs. No source guard budget changed.
